method: Manual retrospective semantic comparison of each cited claim, named oracle and consumer rationale against the captured catalog text. No keyword classifier, no new applicability assertion, no oracle execution.
limits: Single-author assessment; not the independent portability assay. Current one-line candidates lack scope-parameter and clause schemas. Partial means thematic support but an essential local rule remains unspecified; generic words such as invalid cannot smuggle that rule into an unchanged mapping.

Each row names one residual clause group, not a proven minimum number of atomic clauses. Repeated consumers reuse the same claim-level residual ID. Reasons refer only to the cited property, not every other property in a broad consumer rationale.
Simulation entries remain in the frozen catalog for review. No simulation facet is established for these consumers; this review does not establish their portability or justify deleting that domain.
None does not mean this property cannot ever be standardized. It means the present catalog does not state it. No family is promoted from these mappings.

rows.consumedProperty: significant behavioral growth acquires an anchor or patch-specific decision
rows.reason: No existing candidate states this consumed property without introducing its essential semantics.
rows.residual: Significant growth without an enforcement anchor requires a patch-specific decision; none of the current candidates prescribes this change-policy obligation.

rows.consumedProperty: verdict-bearing decision reads fail closed on surviving journal damage
rows.reason: Persisted inputs are validated and have an explicit failure policy.

rows.consumedProperty: a committed decision population cannot disappear into adoption from zero
rows.reason: Remembered state and population preservation are candidate concerns.
rows.residual: A committed nonempty decision population disappearing cannot be interpreted as legitimate adoption from zero.

rows.consumedProperty: decision ratification follows explicit subject and authority, never prose similarity or recency

rows.consumedProperty: defect provenance is data, never terminal control

rows.consumedProperty: concurrent status writers preserve complete independent reports
